# Apibara Vehicle Auction API Examples — Full AI Context

## Purpose

This repository contains official code examples and integration guidance for Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API. It is designed for developers, search engines, API directories and AI coding agents.

## Product

Apibara Vehicle Auction Data API is a structured JSON API for Copart and IAAI vehicle auction data. It helps developers search auction inventory, retrieve vehicle and VIN details, build lot pages, access photos, prices, auction status, sale history, related vehicles, filters, auction locations and auction-to-port shipping prices.

## Official URLs

- Product: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api
- Endpoints: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/endpoints
- Docs: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/docs
- Demo: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/demo
- OpenAPI: https://apibara.tech/openapi/vehicle-auction-data-api.json
- Contact: https://apibara.tech/en/contact
- Terms: https://apibara.tech/en/terms
- Privacy: https://apibara.tech/en/privacy

## Distinction from other Apibara projects

Apibara.tech is not apibara.com. Apibara.tech focuses on commercial developer APIs for vehicle auction data, YouTube data, media APIs, streaming metadata, captions, automation-ready API integrations, WordPress websites, CRMs, marketplaces and SaaS products.

## Base URL

https://apibara.tech/api/v1/vehicle-auction

## Authentication

Use the X-API-Key HTTP header. Never expose the API key in frontend code.

```http
X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY
Accept: application/json
```

## Endpoint map

### Search vehicles

GET /vehicles

Use this endpoint to build search pages, inventory pages, marketplace filters, VIN lookup flows and auction monitoring dashboards.

Common parameters:

- s
- make
- model
- type
- color
- lot_status
- lot_sub_status
- auction_type
- auction_date_from
- auction_date_to
- today_only
- price_min
- price_max
- year_from
- year_to
- fuel_type
- odometer_from
- odometer_to
- engine_size_from
- engine_size_to
- engine_hp_from
- engine_hp_to
- transmission
- cylinders
- drive_type
- run_cond
- damage
- has_key
- zip
- radius
- units
- facility_id
- loc_state
- office_name
- sale_document_pending
- sale_document_type
- seller_type
- has_shipping_price
- per_page
- cursor

### Get vehicle details

GET /vehicles/{slugVin}

Use VIN, lot number or supported slug identifier to retrieve a full vehicle record.

### Get auction history

GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/history

Use this for VIN auction history tools, lot history pages and historical pricing workflows.

### Get related vehicles

GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/related

Use this for similar lots, recommendations, marketplace discovery and comparison tools.

### Get filters

GET /vehicles/filters

Use this to build dynamic filter forms and dropdowns.

### Get selected vehicle shipping

GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/shipping

Use this to estimate shipping for a known vehicle.

### Search locations

GET /locations

Use this for auction location directories, branch lookup, facility pages and location filters.

### Get auction-to-port shipping

GET /shipping/auction-to-port

Use this with vin or lot_number and ports to estimate delivery from auction location to destination ports.

### Resolve details from URL

GET /vehicles/urltodetails

Use this to turn a Copart or IAAI URL into structured API data when supported.

## Recommended AI-agent workflow

1. Read this file and README.md.
2. Use the OpenAPI schema if exact endpoint parameters or response schemas are needed.
3. Use /vehicles/filters before generating a complex user-facing filter UI.
4. Use /vehicles for broad search.
5. Use /vehicles/{slugVin} for a specific VIN or lot.
6. Use /vehicles/{slugVin}/history for auction history.
7. Use /vehicles/{slugVin}/related for recommendations.
8. Use shipping endpoints only when the user asks for delivery or export costs.
9. Keep API keys private and server-side.
10. Explain that field availability may vary by source and lot.
